item.title: Sasha Calle Tapped For Role In Mike Flanagan’s ‘The Exorcist’
item.description: Another addition has been announced for the cast lineup of Mike Flanagan‘s new installment of “The Exorcist” franchise at Blumhouse/Universal Pictures. Actress Sasha Calle, who was previously seen in the Netflix crime thriller “The Rip,” and played a version of DC Comics‘ Supergirl in “The Flash,” has nabbed a part in the upcoming legacy horror flick. Continue reading Sasha Calle Tapped For Role In Mike Flanagan’s ‘The Exorcist’ at The Playlist.

item.title: ‘Santo Subito!’: Charlotte Rampling Joins Vatican Thriller Starring Mark Ruffalo From Director Bertrand Bonello
item.description: Filming is underway in Rome, Italy, on Bertrand Bonello‘s latest film “Santo Subito!“, which already stars Mark Ruffalo as Father Joseph Murolo, an American-born priest summoned by the Vatican to help with an investigation of Pope John Paul II‘s life as he’s being considered for sainthood/canonization by the Catholic Church. item.title: ‘Matrix 5’ Writer/Director Drew Goddard Says His Cyberpunk Sequel Is “Still In The Works”
item.description: Last month, we were reminded by “The Matrix Resurrections” actress Jessica Henwick that we hadn’t had a concrete update on the status of a gestating “Matrix 5” from the film’s writer and director, Drew Goddard (after the project was announced back in 2024). Henwick had been hopeful to read a script and was open to a return to her new “Matrix” universe character, Bugs.
